columns.name: product_id
columns.description: The unique id number identifying the product.

columns.name: has_over_1_price_changes
columns.description: Set to 1 if the product has more than 1 price changes, 0 otherwise.

columns.name: does_not_have_work_order
columns.description: Set to 1 if the product does not have a work order, 0 otherwise.

columns.name: num_reviews
columns.description: The number of reviews the product has received, replace null values with 0.

columns.name: sold_by_over_2_vendors
columns.description: Set to 1 if the product is sold by more than 2 vendors, 0 otherwise.

columns.name: num_orders
columns.description: The number of orders the product has, replace null values with 0.
